articles.title: China Patches Its Outbound Investment Management Regime: What Europeans Shall Know
articles.excerpt: The implementation of the State Council's landmark Regulations on Outbound Investment marks a historic transition. For the first time, China's outbound capital oversight has been elevated from a fragmented web of departmental rules to a unified, statutory administrative law.
articles.author: Sofos | & Partners PRC

articles.title: When the Signature Won't Travel: A Guide to China's Cross-Border Paperwork Trap
articles.excerpt: If you are an in-house counsel managing a Foreign-Invested Enterprise (FIE) in China, you've probably hit this wall: You have a perfectly executed DocuSign envelope from your offshore CEO — legally binding, flawless audit trail — and China rejects it.
articles.author: Sofos | & Partners PRC
